checks.statute_locator: KSpTG section3 numbers6 and6a; official text last amended25November2025

assessment: Retain the narrow correction as a minor provisional finding. The relevant functional CO2 pipeline and network definitions contain no national or Land-border condition. CMA’s express by-definition clause makes a universal premise in support of nationwide inspection uniformity. The candidate accurately preserves the reasonable alternative that CMA informally meant an interregional backbone, and does not claim this invalidates nationwide safety regulation.
materiality: A supporting premise for national uniformity is inaccurate; correcting it narrows the scope of that argument. No numerical safety/cost conclusion changes and the case for common connected-network rules remains. Minor is proportionate; do not promote this as a central refutation.

direction.reason: Universal multi-Land routing strengthens the request for nationwide procedures. This is a narrow direction judgement, not proof that CMA benefits economically from the inaccurate wording.
